faq.q: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. All image loading and comparison happens entirely in your browser. Your images never leave your device.

faq.q: What is the best mode for compression comparison?
faq.a: The Slider mode is best — drag the slider slowly across details to see exactly where quality was lost during compression.

faq.q: Can I compare images of different sizes?
faq.a: Yes, but for the best experience, the images are displayed at their natural size. In Slider and Overlay modes, Image B is scaled to match Image A's dimensions.
Yes, click "Download Comparison" to save a side-by-side PNG of both images. This is useful for sharing or documenting before/after results.
We support JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP for input. The downloaded comparison is always PNG format.

faq.q: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a: There is no hard limit, but very large images (over 5000px wide) may be slow to render. For best performance, resize large images before comparing.

faq.q: Can I use this for commercial projects?
faq.a: Absolutely. The output images are yours to use for any purpose — personal or commercial.
